info.description:
HTTP API for AI Product Video Studio.

Long-running AI work (analysis, shot generation, TTS, render, QC) is **never**
performed inside a request. Those endpoints validate, create a `GenerationJob`,
enqueue it and return `202 Accepted` with a `job_id` to poll (taskbook §22).

Every failure returns the same envelope:

```json
{"error": {"code": "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND", "message": "...", "request_id": "..."}}
```

`code` comes from a closed set (§65) and is the field clients should branch on.
info.title: AI Product Video Studio API

get.description:
Describe this API version.

Reports which feature flags are on so a client can adapt without probing
endpoints that are deliberately disabled.

post.description:
Exchange email and password for tokens.

Every failure returns the same error regardless of cause, and the
no-such-user path still performs a password hash, so neither the response
nor its timing reveals whether an email is registered.

Revoke the refresh token and clear the cookie.

Succeeds even without a valid token: a logout that fails leaves the user
believing they are signed out when they are not.

Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.

The presented token is revoked as part of the exchange, so a stolen one is
usable at most once.

Register a user and their personal workspace, then sign them in.

A user without a workspace cannot use the product at all, so both are
created in one transaction.

get.description: Every workspace the caller belongs to. Never any others.

schema.title: Response List Workspaces Api V1 Workspaces Get

post.description: Create a workspace. The caller becomes its OWNER.

get.description:
Fetch one workspace.

Returns 404 — not 403 — when the caller is not a member, so workspace ids
cannot be probed for existence across tenants.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Members Get

post.description:
Add an existing user. Requires `member:invite`.

Granting OWNER additionally requires `member:update_role`, so an admin
cannot escalate by inviting an account they control as an owner.

delete.description:
Remove a member, or leave the workspace yourself.

Leaving needs no permission; removing someone else requires
`member:remove`. Removing the last owner is refused either way.

patch.description:
Change a role. Requires `member:update_role` (OWNER only).

Demoting the last owner is refused: a workspace with no owner cannot be
billed, deleted, or have its membership managed.

get.description: Report that the process is alive. Never touches backing services.

Report whether every backing service is usable.

Returns 503 when any dependency fails so load balancers stop routing here
rather than serving errors to users. Probes run concurrently: three
sequential timeouts would exceed most orchestrators' probe budget.

503.description: One or more dependencies are not ready.
